title: Edge backend egress policy response v1
description: GET /backend-egress-policy response for the immutable process policy. JWT namespace authorization and Cache-Control: no-store are HTTP/runtime requirements. JSON conformance cannot establish authentication, serving DP identity or actual enforcement; CP metadata is not DP attestation.

x-contract.name: backend-egress-policy
x-contract.edge_availability: Released since Ferrum Edge v0.9.11; re-read at verified v0.9.12 source 0d917701b63ef38210c49df830f48cf0457cbc7d. Canonical contracts-edge-0.9.11 is published; contracts-edge-0.9.12 publication is pending.

provenance.note: Transcribed OpenAPI response shape. Additional cross-field assertions copy the handler's exact mode class lists and public-only guarantee calculation; no authorization or cryptographic validity is modeled as JSON validation.

ip_classification.description: Versioned Edge private/reserved classifier; public is its complement. Exact v1 ranges, recognized IPv4 embeddings and global IETF exceptions are documented in the pinned owner admin_api.md.

namespace.description: Authorized request namespace; absent request header selects ferrum.

policy_scope.description: Process-wide immutable loaded policy; changing it requires a process restart.

enforcement_scope.description: local-data-plane serves this namespace; unserved-namespace serves another. admission-only is CP without a local proxy; no-data-plane includes node_agent. CP and non-serving metadata do not attest remote DP policy.

mode.description: Loaded mode; production default is both.

mode_allowed_ip_classes.description: Mode-stage classes only, after overlays and dangerous baseline; not unconditional effective allows.

mode_blocked_ip_classes.description: Mode-stage blocks; explicit allow CIDRs can bypass them.

dangerous_ranges_blocked.description: Loaded dangerous-range baseline, production default true. Explicit allows can bypass it; it permits ordinary loopback/RFC1918/ULA under both mode and alone does not certify public-only egress.

allow_cidr_overrides_present.description: Whether explicit allow CIDRs are loaded; addresses and counts are withheld.

deny_cidr_overrides_present.description: Whether explicit deny CIDRs are loaded; addresses and counts are withheld.

evaluation_order.description: First match for each address and recognized embedded IPv4 candidate. Ambiguous local-use NAT64 must pass both decoded candidates and the literal IPv6 policy.

public_only_guaranteed.description: True exactly for public mode without allow overrides. This loaded-policy fact is usable for a serving gateway only with local-data-plane for the requested namespace; it is not DNS validation, a connect test, or external firewall attestation.
